messages.subject: "tidystats"in lavaan
parts:
Can the package "tidystats" be used to display results from a analysis using lavaan?

I have tried doing this but receive the following error message: 

Error in UseMethod("tidy_stats") : 
  no applicable method for 'tidy_stats' applied to an object of class "lavaan"

Best regards,
Marit Larsen PhD student

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: "tidystats"in lavaan
parts:
On 10/14/19 11:10 AM, Marit Larsen wrote:
>
> Can the package "tidystats" be used to display results from a analysis
> using lavaan?

No. Because the tidystats package only supports a few classic tests from
the stats package. See:

https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/tidystats/readme/README.html

You should contact the author of the tidystats package.

Yves.
